mandate: governed swing and position research; no scalping, social-momentum scalping or low-float speculation

states.ADMITTED: clears the quality layer; all ordinary arithmetic, event, risk and independent-review gates still apply
states.RESEARCH_ONLY: preserve evidence and monitor, but withhold current new-entry mechanics
states.QUARANTINED: hard new-entry refusal; retained only for audit or existing-position management

small_cap_policy: operator decision 2026-09-15: small caps are in scope; a market cap below the $500M floor or the $1B preferred tier is labeled SMALL_CAP / MICRO_CAP / NANO_CAP instead of quarantined or demoted. Price, float, volatility, thesis and freshness gates are unchanged.
